description: Delivery/retry/checkpoint semantics per engine — what each engine can evidence, not what it guarantees in every deployment.

kafka.delivery: at_least_once_by_default; exactly_once requires transactions+idempotent producer+read_committed consumer
kafka.dedup: producer idempotence; no broker-side dedup for consumer retries

kinesis.dedup: producer dedup via sequence numbers within put

pubsub.delivery: at_least_once default; exactly-once delivery option per subscription

flink.delivery: effectively_once via checkpointing + two-phase commit sinks

spark.delivery: structured streaming: effectively_once with checkpoint + idempotent sink

snowflake.delivery: dml statements are atomic; pipelines via streams/tasks are at_least_once

bigquery.delivery: insertId dedup for streaming inserts (best-effort window)
bigquery.checkpoint: n/a for batch; storage write api supports exactly-once streams
